claims.sentence: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title> <jats:sec id="s001"> <jats:title>OBJECTIVE</jats:title> <jats:p>To determine whether blood taurine concentrations in dogs with exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (EPI) were lower than the reference interval (200 to 350 nmol/mL) or the cutoff used to indicate taurine deficiency (< 150 nmol/mL).</jats:p> </jats:sec> <jats:sec id="s002"> <jats:title>ANIMALS</jats:title> <jats:p>18 dogs with clinical or presumptive subclinical EPI with residual blood samples available for taurine concentration analysis.</jats:p> </jats:sec> <jats:sec id="s003"> <jats:title>PROCEDURES</jats:title> <jats:p>Dogs were classified as having clinical EPI if they had a serum trypsin-like immunoreactivity concentration of < 2.0 μg/L and presumptive subclinical EPI if they had a concentration of 2.0 to 5.0 μg/L.
